chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:

"Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has disliked six traits for me, and I have disliked them for the successors from among my progeny and their followers after me. One of them is indecency during fasting."

key_terms.اَلرَّفَثُ: indecent, obscene, or sexually explicit speech
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted; a formula of divine glorification
key_terms.لِلْأَوْصِيَاءِ: for the successors; referring to the designated heirs of religious authority

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about indecency and proper conduct during fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, disliked six traits for the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, and that he likewise disliked them for the awsiya' from among his offspring and their followers. One of these traits is obscene or indecent speech during sawm, showing that fasting includes moral restraint in addition to abstention from food and drink.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1856 - The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, has disliked six traits for me, and I have disliked them for the successors from among my progeny and their followers after me. One of them is indecency during fasting."
